episodes.title: In This Town, A Number Shows How Many People Love You… Mine Is 0 💔 #roblox #shorts
episodes.script: In this town, everyone has a number above their head. It counts how many people love you. My mom has thirty. The mayor has nine hundred. Mine has always been zero. Kids laughed. Teachers looked away. I stopped going outside. Then one night the power went out, and a little girl was stuck in the dark, crying. I gave her my flashlight and walked her home. The next morning, my number said one. I smiled… until I saw hers. Her number had always been zero too. Now it said one. It was me.

episodes.title: In This Town, You NEVER Fall Asleep Outside… 😨 #roblox #shorts
episodes.script: In this town, you never fall asleep outside. Not on a bench. Not in the park. Not even for a minute. Because when the streetlights flicker, anyone sleeping outside is gone by morning. Nobody knows where they go. Last night, I saw my little brother asleep on the swings. The lights started flickering. I ran. I grabbed his arm. And then I heard the lights… whisper. Not him. We want the one who hasn't slept in three days. I haven't slept since Tuesday. I always wondered why the streetlights followed me home.

episodes.title: In This Town, Every Kind Thing You Do Drops A Gold Coin 🪙 #roblox #shorts
episodes.script: In this town, every kind thing you do drops a gold coin. Hold a door? One coin. Help someone up? Five. So everyone is kind… but only when they're watching for coins. Then there's old Mister Abe. He fixes bikes for free, and he never picks up his coins. People call him crazy. When he got sick, the whole town found out why. Behind his house was a mountain of gold, as tall as the clock tower. And a sign that said: for whoever needs it more. He never did it for the coins. That's why there were so many.

episodes.title: In This Town, Your Future Self Calls You Once… 📞 #roblox #shorts
episodes.script: In this town, on your thirteenth birthday, your phone rings once. It's you, from the future. They tell you one thing. My sister's said, take the job in the city. She's rich now. My friend's said, say sorry to Dad. He did. I turned thirteen today. The phone rang. I picked it up. Silence. Then breathing. Then a voice that sounded exactly like me said: don't answer the phone. I looked at the screen. The call was coming from inside my house.

episodes.title: In This Town, Running Is ILLEGAL… 🏃‍♂️❌ #roblox #shorts
episodes.script: In this town, running is illegal. Walking only. Even our races are speed-walking. Because if you run, the ground cracks under your feet. Grandma says the town is built on a sleeping giant, and fast footsteps wake him up. I never believed her. Today I was late for school. I looked left. I looked right. I ran. The ground shook. The street split open. A giant eye opened under the road. It looked right at me and said: bro. It's seven a.m. Then it went back to sleep. I still got detention.
